task: The person repeatedly assembles and takes apart a small orange toy table made of five plastic parts. To assemble it, the parts are picked up from the desk one at a time and fitted together, usually with one hand holding the partial assembly and the other bringing and pressing in a part; to take it apart, the parts are pulled off and put back down on the desk.

objects.name: tabletop
objects.description: the flat orange rectangular plate with a row of three round holes; the top of the toy table

objects.name: leg frame
objects.description: one of two H-shaped orange pieces; each is a pair of legs joined by a short bar

objects.name: stretcher
objects.description: one of two long, thin, straight orange bars that connect the two leg frames

objects.name: toy table
objects.description: the orange parts when fully or partly fitted together

source: written by Claude from the 16 frames evenly sampled over the take (take_frames/)
